verdict.rationale: Cooley is a law firm whose user-facing offerings are free legal document generators (Cooley GO), guidance content and financing data. It has no user-built automation or workflow product, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back user automations is a category error for this product type. The S-1 drafting and update prompts describe an internal tool for Cooley's own lawyers, not user-managed automations. Nothing in the evidence shows a shipped automation-management capability.
